quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #24
										  					
  

40 Questions • Passing Score 32

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Crossroad ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you of an intersection ahead.

questions.question: When driving through a roundabout, what should you do?

options.text: Yield to traffic already in the roundabout.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to traffic already in the roundabout.
questions.explanation: A roundabout is a circular intersection with no traffic signal. Enter from the right and yield to cars already in the roundabout. Follow the circle counterclockwise until you reach your exit.

questions.question: When can you cross double solid yellow lines?
questions.correctAnswerText: To turn into a driveway.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean you cannot pass or change lanes. You can only cross them to turn left into a driveway, enter or exit a highway, or make a U-turn where permitted.

questions.question: How far must you park from a crosswalk?
questions.correctAnswerText: 20 feet
questions.explanation: You must park at least 20 feet away from a crosswalk.

questions.question: A solid white line on the right edge of the road slants toward the left. What does this mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: The road will get narrower.
questions.explanation: A solid line on the road edge shows the boundary between the travel lane and the shoulder. When the line angles toward the center, the road is getting narrower ahead.

questions.question: You see a flashing yellow light at an intersection. What should you do?

options.text: Stop and wait for the light to change.
Make a U-turn because the intersection is closed.
Prepare to stop; the light is about to turn red.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive carefully through the intersection.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means proceed slowly and with caution. Look both ways before entering the intersection.

questions.question: What is the safest way to back up your vehicle?

options.text: Honk your horn right before shifting into reverse.
Check behind the vehicle before you get in the driver's seat.
Check your rearview mirrors to see what is behind you.
Turn up the car radio before backing up to get attention.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check behind the vehicle before you get in the driver's seat.
questions.explanation: Backing is risky because drivers cannot see well behind their vehicles. Always walk to the back of your vehicle to check for children and small objects before getting in to back up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and carpools.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What is the minimum following distance when driving behind a motorcycle?
questions.correctAnswerText: Four seconds.
questions.explanation: Keep at least four seconds of distance behind a motorcycle. If the motorcycle falls, you need extra space to avoid it safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: Low clearance.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you of low clearance ahead.

questions.question: What color are signs that mark public recreation areas?
questions.correctAnswerText: Brown
questions.explanation: Brown signs mark places of cultural, historical, or recreational interest. They help drivers find important locations when traveling in new areas.

questions.question: Blood alcohol content (BAC) does NOT depend on:

options.text: How much time passes between drinks

questions.correctAnswerText: How physically fit you are
questions.explanation: BAC depends on how much you drink, time between drinks, and your weight. Physical fitness level does not affect BAC.

questions.question: What is a "No zone"?

options.text: The blind spot around a large vehicle
An area for motor vehicles only

questions.correctAnswerText: The blind spot around a large vehicle
questions.explanation: A "No zone" is a blind spot around trucks and large vehicles. Smaller vehicles should not stay in these areas.

questions.question: You must pull over for an emergency vehicle:

options.text: No matter which direction it is coming from
Only if it is behind you
Only if it is coming toward you

questions.correctAnswerText: No matter which direction it is coming from
questions.explanation: Pull over to the right and stop for any emergency vehicle with flashing lights, whether it is coming from behind or the opposite direction.

questions.question: Why should you adjust your headrest before driving?

options.text: It can help prevent whiplash injuries
It makes the seat more comfortable
It can block your rearview mirror

questions.correctAnswerText: It can help prevent whiplash injuries
questions.explanation: Headrests protect you from whiplash during crashes. Adjusting your headrest is an important safety step before you drive.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Slippery when wet
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black text on a yellow background. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign tells you to slow down and be careful when the road is wet, as your vehicle may be harder to control.

questions.question: You should be careful when passing a bicycle because:

options.text: Your car is faster than the bicycle
Oncoming traffic may not see you passing
The cyclist may swerve into traffic to avoid an object

questions.correctAnswerText: The cyclist may swerve into traffic to avoid an object
questions.explanation: Always be careful passing bicycles because the cyclist may suddenly move into your lane to avoid something on the road. Always drive carefully near bicyclists.

questions.question: When leaving a highway, you should slow down:

options.text: On the main road just before the exit
When you see a toll booth
After you move into the exit lane
When you see the exit sign

questions.correctAnswerText: After you move into the exit lane
questions.explanation: Move into the exit lane well ahead of your exit. Do not slow down until after you are in the exit lane.

questions.question: A broken yellow line in the center of a two-lane road means:

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions and you cannot pass
Traffic moves in opposite directions and you can pass when safe
Traffic moves in the same direction and you cannot pass
Traffic moves in the same direction and you can pass when safe

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in opposite directions and you can pass when safe
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. A broken yellow line means drivers next to it can pass when it is safe.

questions.question: When parallel parking, you should first:

options.text: Turn your wheels to the left
Turn your wheels to the right
Stop even with the car in front of the parking space

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop even with the car in front of the parking space
questions.explanation: After finding a parking space and checking traffic, stop parallel to the car ahead of your space. Then turn your wheels and park.

questions.question: You want to back out of your driveway. You see children playing nearby. What should you do before you start to move your car?

options.text: Rev your engine to warn the children.
Sound your horn so the children hear you.
Walk to the back of the car to make sure the way is clear.
Tell the children to stay away from the driveway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Walk to the back of the car to make sure the way is clear.
questions.explanation: When backing up, look through your back window for people and obstacles. Do not rely only on your mirrors, especially with children nearby. Always get out and check behind your car before backing.

questions.question: To pass a slower vehicle on a two-lane, two-way road, you must:

options.text: Flash your lights at oncoming traffic.
Use the lane for oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use the lane for oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: To pass on a two-lane, two-way road, you must use the lane for oncoming traffic to complete your pass. Only pass if you can do so safely and legally.

questions.question: You come to an intersection blocked by traffic. What should you do?

options.text: Go slowly until traffic ahead moves.
Get as close as possible to the car in front of you.
Stay out of the intersection until you can drive through it completely.
Sound your horn to make cars move forward.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay out of the intersection until you can drive through it completely.
questions.explanation: Do not enter an intersection if traffic is blocked on the other side and you cannot get completely through. Wait until traffic clears so you do not block the intersection.

questions.question: Your body gets rid of approximately how much alcohol per hour?
questions.correctAnswerText: One drink an hour.
questions.explanation: The average person's body processes about one drink in one hour. However, how impaired you become depends on many factors: how much you drink, how fast you drink it, your body weight, whether you have eaten, and your overall health.

questions.question: Which recommendation does NOT help you drive safely at night?

options.text: Know that tinted windows reduce visibility in the dark.
Carry a flashlight in your vehicle.
Look directly into the headlights of oncoming vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look directly into the headlights of oncoming vehicles.
questions.explanation: When you look into oncoming headlights, your pupils shrink. After the vehicle passes, your eyes need time to adjust back to the darker light. During this time, you cannot see well.

questions.question: Which of the following is a characteristic of a defensive driver?
questions.correctAnswerText: Good judgment.
questions.explanation: Defensive drivers pay attention to their surroundings. In bad weather, they slow down to control their vehicle. They do not take risks like running red lights or racing trains.

questions.question: You approach an intersection when the light turns from green to solid yellow. What should you do?

options.text: Treat it as a caution sign and continue through.
Stop before entering the intersection, unless you are too close to stop safely.
Speed up to get through before the red light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop before entering the intersection, unless you are too close to stop safely.
questions.explanation: When you see a solid yellow light, slow down and stop before entering the intersection if you can do so safely. If you are too close to stop, drive carefully through.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.correctAnswerText: Yield.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means "Yield." When you see it, slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles go first. Stop only if needed.

questions.question: If you need to stop quickly and your car does not have an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS), what should you do?
questions.correctAnswerText: Pump your brakes firmly.
questions.explanation: Pumping the brakes is the best way to stop quickly in an emergency. Your car will stop faster and you can still steer.

questions.question: What does the "S" in the SIPDE acronym mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Sweep, Search, and Scan.
questions.explanation: The "S" in SIPDE stands for "Sweep, Search, and Scan." Keep your eyes moving at all times to spot danger early.

questions.question: How do you check your blind spots before changing lanes?

options.text: Use both inside and outside rearview mirrors.
Turn your head and look over your shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look over your shoulder.
questions.explanation: Turn your head to check your blind spots before changing lanes.

questions.question: What should you do if a car has bright headlights shining at you?

options.text: Use your bright lights until the other driver dims theirs.
Flash your lights on and off to warn the other driver.
Dim your lights and then speed up to pass quickly.
Look toward the right side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look toward the right side of the road.
questions.explanation: Look away from the headlights and toward the right side of the road. This keeps you from being blinded until the car passes.

questions.question: What should you do before turning?

options.text: Always come to a complete stop.
Slow down, but only if road conditions are poor.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down.
questions.explanation: Slow down before turning. This is the safest way to make a turn. Turning too fast can cause you to lose control.

questions.question: Your car has an Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS). If you start to lose traction on a slippery road, what should you do?

options.text: Press and hold the brake pedal.
Press and hold the gas pedal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Press and hold the brake pedal.
questions.explanation: Press hard on the brake pedal and hold it while steering to safety. The ABS automatically pumps the brakes faster than you can. Do not pump the brakes or release pressure, as this will turn off the ABS.

questions.question: A flashing red traffic light means the same thing as:
questions.correctAnswerText: A stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red traffic light means stop. Come to a complete stop and proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: When parking downhill on a two-way street, which way should you turn your wheels?

options.text: Turn your wheels to the right.
Turn your wheels to the left.
Keep your wheels pointed straight ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your wheels to the right.
questions.explanation: Turn your wheels toward the side of the road. If your car rolls downhill, it will roll away from traffic.

questions.question: Why is it important to watch out for motorcycles?

options.text: They are harder to see than cars.
Motorcyclists are less skilled drivers than other motorists.

questions.correctAnswerText: They are harder to see than cars.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles are smaller and easier to miss than cars. They can hide in your blind spot. It is hard to judge your distance from a motorcycle and how fast it is moving. Stay alert and cautious around motorcycles.

questions.question: What color are most warning signs?
questions.correctAnswerText: Yellow.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They warn you of unexpected conditions ahead.

questions.question: You see a solid yellow line and a broken yellow line in the middle of the road. The broken line is next to your lane. When can you pass?
questions.correctAnswerText: If traffic is clear.
questions.explanation: You may pass if there is no oncoming traffic.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Winding road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a series of turns and curves.
